description: This file defines the InventoryStock entity class, which models inventory stock data for a store, including fields for store ID, SKU, on-hand count, reserved quantity, timestamps, and versioning for concurrency control.

classes.name: InventoryStock
classes.description: Represents an inventory stock record associated with a store and SKU, tracking stock counts and concurrency version.

methods.name: InventoryStock(Long storeId, String sku, int onHand, int reserved)
methods.description: Constructor to create a new InventoryStock with specified store, SKU, onHand and reserved counts.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the inventory stock record.

methods.name: getStoreId()
methods.description: Returns the store ID associated with the stock.

methods.name: getOnHand()
methods.description: Returns the number of items on hand.

methods.name: getReserved()
methods.description: Returns the number of reserved items.

methods.name: getCreatedAt()
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the record was created.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt()
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the record was last updated.
